tasks.short: Inspect construction projects and analyze engineering problems using tests or drilling.

steps.what: Inspect actual construction conditions and conduct necessary test-equipment or drilling observations
inputs: actual test equipment or drilling machinery
outputs: actual field observations and instrument files

steps.what: Transfer actual instrument readings and field identifiers into the geotechnical project record
inputs: actual field observations and instrument files

steps.what: Interpret actual conditions and test results and write checked engineering problem findings
inputs: actual field observations and instrument files
outputs: checked field analysis and test record

steps.what: Save the checked field analysis and actual test record
inputs: checked field analysis and test record

tasks.human_edge: Relate actual ground evidence to the engineering problem.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native geotechnical imports can reduce re-keying supported instrument data while preserving field and engineering judgement.

tasks.short: Evaluate methane-resource energy methods and their environmental impacts.

steps.what: Find and read actual geomethane, hydrate and environmental evidence relevant to the study
Define candidate incorporation methods, scenarios, boundaries and explicit scientific assumptions
Set and check scenario inputs and repeat selected energy and environmental model calculations
Judge method feasibility, environmental consequences, uncertainty and limits of the modeled evidence
Write and check actual methane-study findings, assumptions and limitations
Save the checked methane study record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} evidence filters and repeatable model scenario runs. The scientist supplies and checks actual assumptions, judges feasibility and impacts, and records qualified findings; no new extraction method is claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source finding and interactive scenario setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters and scenario batch settings.
tasks.still_hard: Resource uncertainty, leakage and extrapolation from limited evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Determine what the evidence can support about methods and environmental consequences.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated scenario handling; research decisions unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native scientific model scenario settings can reduce repeated interactive setup without resolving resource feasibility or environmental uncertainty.

assumptions: Boundary is method and environmental-impact research through its actual study record, not physical extraction or deployment. Source producers provide actual composition, pressure, temperature, recovery assumptions, emissions factors and uncertainty evidence; scientist checks sources in s1 and specifies scenario values in s2-s3. Missing evidence requires manual research or an explicitly unresolved assumption.

Native first. Provisional shares, not measured; repeated human setup only, existing automatic compute earns zero. s3 retains parameter capture and output checks; all scientific interpretation remains. Save1 fully retained, ordinary writing checks not an added approval ceremony.
unknowns: Actual model availability and source coverage
research_questions: Which repeated scenario operations remain manual in the chosen scientific model?

tasks.short: Develop ways to capture or use waste gases from oil production.

steps.what: Establish actual waste-gas composition, flow, variability and production-site constraints
Develop candidate capture or use concepts and choose explicit test scenarios
outputs: candidate gas concepts and test scenarios

steps.what: Enter checked inputs and repeat mass, energy and feasibility calculations for candidate concepts
inputs: candidate gas concepts and test scenarios

steps.what: Interpret actual results and refine capture or use concepts and unresolved technical risks
inputs: candidate gas concepts and test scenarios

steps.what: Write and check the actual concept findings, assumptions and required further tests
Save the checked gas development record

tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calculation assembly across candidate concepts.

Measurement producers supply actual composition, flow, conditions, time and uncertainty; scientist verifies in s1 and chooses scenario assumptions in s2-s3. Missing data require actual measurement or explicit unresolved assumptions, not invented values.

tasks.short: Collaborate on health problems related to geological materials or processes.

steps.what: Find actual geological exposure evidence and relevant project research records
Discuss actual geological and health-research questions with medical or health researchers
Perform the actual geological analysis and interpret exposure or process findings within the collaboration
Write and check the actual geological contribution in the shared research document
Save the checked contribution in the shared research document

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: shared source links and contribution templates reduce document preparation while retaining actual interdisciplinary research.

Missing or disputed observations require manual research.
